review.mathematicalCheck: Equal diagonals in a parallelogram imply congruent triangles ABD and BAC by SSS, making adjacent angles equal. Those angles are supplementary, so both are right angles. Thus a rectangle is guaranteed, choice C; equal sides and a square are not guaranteed. The retained standard criterion sufficiently explains this recognition exercise.
